note: De dage, hvor noget blev bevist, maalt eller sat i kredsloeb. Ét oejeblik hver, saa de kun hoerer med, hvis de falder inden for det indtastede liv.

days.why_da: Samme dag som Abraham Lincoln, på hver sin side af Atlanten.
days.why_en: The same day as Abraham Lincoln, on opposite sides of the Atlantic.

days.en: On the Origin of Species is published
days.why_da: Darwin havde siddet på idéen i tyve år, før Alfred Russel Wallace sendte ham et brev med den samme tanke og tvang ham til at udgive.
days.why_en: Darwin sat on the idea for twenty years, until Alfred Russel Wallace sent him a letter containing the same thought and forced his hand.

days.why_da: Alexander Graham Bell til sin assistent i værelset ved siden af: „Mr. Watson, come here, I want to see you.“
days.why_en: Alexander Graham Bell to his assistant in the next room: “Mr. Watson, come here, I want to see you.”

days.why_da: Under en total solformørkelse måler to ekspeditioner — én i Brasilien, én ved Vestafrika — hvordan stjernelys bøjer af omkring Solen. Afbøjningen var præcis den, Einstein havde regnet ud, og dobbelt så stor som Newton tillod.
days.why_en: During a total solar eclipse two expeditions — one in Brazil, one off West Africa — measure how starlight bends around the Sun. The deflection was exactly what Einstein had calculated, and twice what Newton allowed.

days.why_da: Resultatet fremlægges for Royal Society i London. Dagen efter stod Einstein på forsiderne, og han var verdensberømt resten af sit liv.
days.why_en: The result is presented to the Royal Society in London. The next morning Einstein was on the front pages, and he stayed world-famous for the rest of his life.

days.why_da: Edwin Hubble fremlægger beviset for, at Andromeda-„tågen“ er en hel anden galakse. Indtil den dag troede man, at Mælkevejen var hele universet.
days.why_en: Edwin Hubble presents the evidence that the Andromeda “nebula” is an entirely separate galaxy. Until that day the Milky Way was thought to be the whole universe.

days.why_da: Tre artikler i samme nummer af Nature. Watson og Cricks er på én side, og den bygger på Rosalind Franklins røntgenbillede, som de havde set uden hendes vidende.
days.why_en: Three papers in the same issue of Nature. Watson and Crick's runs to a single page, and it rests on Rosalind Franklin's X-ray image, which they had seen without her knowledge.

days.why_da: En 58 cm metalkugle med fire antenner, der bippede i 21 dage. Den satte rumkapløbet i gang og skræmte en hel verdensdel.
days.why_en: A 58 cm metal sphere with four antennae that beeped for 21 days. It started the space race and frightened an entire continent.

days.why_da: Jurij Gagarin rundede Jorden én gang i 108 minutter. Han var 27 år og havde ingen kontrol over kapslen — man vidste ikke, om et menneske kunne tænke i vægtløshed.
days.why_en: Yuri Gagarin went round the Earth once in 108 minutes. He was 27 and had no control of the capsule — nobody knew whether a human could think in weightlessness.

days.en: The echo of the Big Bang is heard
days.why_da: Arno Penzias og Robert Wilson rensede en kæmpe hornantenne i New Jersey for al tænkelig støj, og der blev en jævn hvislen tilbage, de ikke kunne komme af med. Det var universets baggrundsstråling — lyset fra 380.000 år efter begyndelsen.
days.why_en: Arno Penzias and Robert Wilson cleaned every conceivable source of noise out of a giant horn antenna in New Jersey, and a uniform hiss was left that they could not get rid of. It was the cosmic microwave background — light from 380,000 years after the beginning.

days.why_da: Månelandingsfartøjet sætter sig i Stilhedens Hav med brændstof til under tyve sekunder tilbage. Armstrong gik ud godt seks timer senere — natten til den 21. i dansk tid.
days.why_en: The lunar module settles in the Sea of Tranquillity with under twenty seconds of fuel left. Armstrong stepped out a good six hours later — in the small hours of the 21st, European time.

days.en: A golf shot on the Moon
days.why_da: Alan Shepard havde smuglet et klubhoved og to bolde med på Apollo 14. I rumdragt kunne han kun svinge med én arm.
days.why_en: Alan Shepard had smuggled a club head and two balls aboard Apollo 14. In a pressure suit he could only swing one-handed.

days.why_da: Spejlet var slebet forkert med en brøkdel af en hårsbredde, og de første billeder var slørede. Det tog tre år og en rumvandring at give det briller.
days.why_en: The mirror had been ground wrong by a fraction of a hair's breadth and the first pictures were blurred. It took three years and a spacewalk to give it glasses.

days.why_da: Første gang en computer vandt et skakparti mod en regerende verdensmester under turneringsvilkår. Kasparov vandt matchen alligevel — men ikke den næste.
days.why_en: The first time a computer won a chess game against a reigning world champion under tournament conditions. Kasparov still won the match — but not the next one.

days.en: Dolly the cloned sheep is announced
days.why_da: Det første pattedyr klonet fra en voksen celle. Cellen kom fra et yver, og derfor blev hun opkaldt efter Dolly Parton.
days.why_en: The first mammal cloned from an adult cell. The cell came from a mammary gland, which is why she was named after Dolly Parton.

days.why_da: Første gang en privatbygget raket med flydende brændstof nåede kredsløb. De tre første forsøg var mislykket, og SpaceX havde penge til netop dette.
days.why_en: The first privately built liquid-fuelled rocket to reach orbit. The three previous attempts had failed, and SpaceX had money for exactly this one.

days.why_da: To sorte huller smeltede sammen for 1,3 milliarder år siden, og rystelsen nåede hertil denne morgen. LIGO målte en bevægelse mindre end en tusindedel af en protons bredde.
days.why_en: Two black holes merged 1.3 billion years ago and the tremor arrived this morning. LIGO measured a movement smaller than a thousandth of the width of a proton.

days.why_da: Fem måneders kontrolregning senere træder LIGO frem. Det var den sidste store ubeviste del af Einsteins almene relativitetsteori — hundrede år efter han skrev den ned.
days.why_en: Five months of checking later, LIGO goes public. It was the last major unproved piece of Einstein's general relativity — a hundred years after he wrote it down.
